podcast.body: Carol Kaye is the bassist on The Beach Boys' seminal hit "Good Vibrations," demonstrating her integral role in one of pop music's most complex productions. Her distinctive bassline is a key component of the song's innovative sound. "Good vibrations with the Beach Boys. That's Carol."
